tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENTS

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder firm must be registered as any of the following a. Individual / proprietary - Firm registration certificate / Trade license of the firm b. Partnership firm - Partnership deed / Registration Certificate of the firm c. Private / Public Limited Company - Certificate of Incorporation. d. Form -C labour registration and The bidder must hold valid copy of GST and PAN registration certificate. Relevant valid registration certificates should be submitted along with GST and PAN Card copies.

The bidder company must have experience in providing the similar kind of preparation of detailed project report of building/Road as mentioned in 3.3 i during the last 5 years. a. One project - 7.5 Marks. b. Two projects -15 Marks.The relevant work done certificates with necessary details about work done shall be submitted issued by the competent Authority

The bidder company should have their owned/hired NABL accredited material testing laboratory 1. Owned NABL Laboratory-15 Marks.2. MOU NABL Laboratory-10 Marks. Certificates by competent authorities / MOU and NABL CERTIFICATE OF ACCREDIATION (copy of downloaded Recommended scope of accreditation should be submitted.
Adequacy of the proposed work plan and Methodology

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Qualifications and competence of the key professional staff. The proposed staff shall be the permanent employee of the firm for at least 2 years.1. Civil Engineer (Team Leader) - 5 Marks. 2. Architect Engineer - 5 Marks. 3. Structural Engineer - 5 Marks. 4. 2 Nos. Civil Engineers - 5 Marks. 5. Quality Engineer -2.5 Marks. 6. Quantity Surveyor- 2.5 Marks. Each staff evaluation will be done by distributing the allotted marks a indicated in the Table -1 Education- 30% Experience- 60% Kannada Language - 10% Relevant CVs of the proposed staff shall be submitted along with proof of 2 years employment in the company roles.

The bidder company must have financial turnover as mentioned in 3.3(i)per year during the last 5 years a. up to Rs 5.0 crore - 05 Marks. b. For Rs 5.00 - Rs 20.00 Crores - 7.5 Marks. d. For Rs 20.00 Crores and above-10 Marks.The Consolidate financial turnover for last three years issued by the CA shall be submitted along with profit & loss statements and ITR copies.
